colorNotes: Logo is monochrome. Electric lime is the single accent: offers, numbers that matter, CTA. Never more than 10% of the frame.

logo.source: Traced from the @adsworm Instagram profile picture (1080px) with potrace — replace with the master vector if one exists.

positioning: Growth partner for clinics (dermatology, dental, hair, aesthetic, multi-branch) — performance ads + scroll-stopping creative, built per city and per treatment.
audience: Clinic owners and doctors running or considering Meta ads in Indian metros and tier-2 cities; secondary: premium salons and local service brands.

motion.notes: Snappy springs, hard cuts on the beat, one idea per beat, kinetic type over black.
